name: hmind
description: A second brain and orchestrator for Claude Code: runs plans of subtasks as parallel subagents that share a board, notes and conventions, integrates and verifies the combined work, governs the agents the model launches itself, guards risky commands, trims noisy output, right-sizes effort, catches unverified done claims, compacts at task boundaries, and keeps a ledger of every model call with its tokens and cost.

judgeModel.title: Judge model
judgeModel.description: Claude model alias that answers Hmind's questions through your session (haiku, sonnet, opus)

confidence.title: Confidence threshold
confidence.description: Below this confidence (0-1) a judge answer is not acted on

orchestrate.title: Orchestrate tool
orchestrate.description: Offer the orchestrate tool: the model hands Hmind a plan of tasks with dependencies and Hmind runs them as parallel subagents

maxParallel.title: Tasks in parallel
maxParallel.description: How many orchestrated tasks run at once (1-8; lowered under budget pressure)

taskTimeoutMin.title: Task timeout (minutes)
taskTimeoutMin.description: An orchestrated task that runs longer is stopped and counted as timed out

retryUp.title: Retry a tier up
retryUp.description: Retry a failed, blocked or timed-out task once on the next stronger model

agentCap.title: Agents at once
agentCap.description: Refuse a new agent the model launches while this many are already running, after holding it a few seconds for a slot (0 = no cap; lowered under budget pressure)

dedupeAgents.title: Refuse duplicate agents
dedupeAgents.description: Refuse an agent whose task duplicates one already running, with the running agent's id in the reason

agentReportOver.title: Digest agent reports over
agentReportOver.description: An agent report longer than this many characters is digested before it reaches the parent; the full text stays available with /hmind report (0 disables)

budgetMode.title: Budget pressure mode
budgetMode.description: Tighten effort, trimming and compaction as the plan's 5-hour and 7-day usage windows fill

bashGuard.title: Shell guard
bashGuard.description: Refuse shell commands judged likely destructive

denyAt.title: Refuse at
denyAt.description: Probability (0-1) of destruction at which a shell command is refused

learnRules.title: Learn allow rules
learnRules.description: When you approve a refused command, remember its shape for this project and stop refusing it

trimOver.title: Trim output over
trimOver.description: Bash output longer than this many characters is judged for trimming (0 disables; shrinks under budget pressure)

digest.title: Digest failures
digest.description: When only the failures matter, have the judge write a compact digest instead of a head-and-tail cut

routeEffort.title: Route effort
routeEffort.description: Lower the model's effort for trivial prompts and small changes

subagents.title: Subagent governance
subagents.description: Route lookup and mechanical subagent work to cheaper models; warn when a fork is launched for a self-contained task

doneCheck.title: Done check
doneCheck.description: What to do when a turn claims completion without running any test, build or check

autoVerify.title: Auto-verify everywhere
autoVerify.description: Run the project's test or build command when a turn claims completion without verification (or enable per project with /hmind verify on)

compactAt.title: Compact at %
compactAt.description: Context fill percentage after which the next task boundary triggers a compaction (0 disables; lowers under budget pressure)
